\usepackage{amsthm}

\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}

\begin{lemma} Every compact space is bounded. \end{lemma}
\begin{theorem} Every finite space is compact. \end{theorem}
\section{Proofs}

A proof of something else.
\end{proof}

\paragraph{Proof of Lemma 1 }
\begin{proof}
Then it holds.
\end{proof}

\paragraph{Proof of Theorem 1}
\begin{proof}
Then it holds.
\end{proof}
